recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is recommended unless a future Security work group decision changes the AuditEvent-to-DICOM mapping model.
issue_request: FHIR-20837 was a Published/Persuasive Security work group change request for R5 asking that AuditEvent's DICOM EventDateTime mapping move from AuditEvent.period to AuditEvent.recorded.
initial_application: The Jira comment links HL7/fhir PR #708. Merge e5f777ad51 and commit 8f93636e05 changed auditevent-spreadsheet.xml by removing EventDateTime from AuditEvent.period and adding it to AuditEvent.recorded; the 33b409a4b6 source conversion preserved the mapping in structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-32444 later renamed AuditEvent.period to AuditEvent.occurred[x] and changed it to Period|dateTime, but did not add a DICOM EventDateTime mapping to occurred[x]. Current source has the only AuditEvent StructureDefinition EventDateTime mapping on AuditEvent.recorded. Community searches found no directly relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source already reflects FHIR-20837 and the later period-to-occurred[x] rename is consistent with that result.

related_jiras.note: Renamed AuditEvent.period to AuditEvent.occurred[x], explaining why the original issue's .period path no longer exists in current source.
